scenes.tts: Separated cells turn neural, yet their B M P receptors keep signaling. How can both be true?
scenes.caption: Separated cells turn neural, yet their BMP receptors keep signaling. How can both be true?
scenes.visual: Title card: One Dial. Scattered cells with active receptors, glowing blue anyway. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: Separated cells turn neural, yet their BMP receptors keep signaling. How can both be true?

scenes.tts: Start by putting the four results in one table.
scenes.visual: An empty table with columns: condition, receptors, Smad1 output, fate.
scenes.narration: Start by putting the four results in one table.

scenes.tts: The intact cap: receptors working, Smad one output high, epidermis.
scenes.caption: The intact cap: receptors working, Smad1 output high, epidermis.
scenes.visual: Row 1 fills: intact cap, working, high, epidermis.
scenes.narration: The intact cap: receptors working, Smad1 output high, epidermis.

scenes.tts: The dominant negative cap: receptors jammed, output low, neural.
scenes.visual: Row 2 fills: dominant-negative receptor, jammed, low, neural.
scenes.narration: The dominant negative cap: receptors jammed, output low, neural.

scenes.tts: Separated cells: neural. Leave their output for a moment.
scenes.visual: Row 3 fills: separated cells, output marked with a question mark, neural.
scenes.narration: Separated cells: neural. Leave their output for a moment.

scenes.tts: Separated cells with B M P four: output high enough, epidermis.
scenes.caption: Separated cells with BMP4: output high enough, epidermis.
scenes.visual: Row 4 fills: separated cells plus BMP4, working, high enough, epidermis.
scenes.narration: Separated cells with BMP4: output high enough, epidermis.

scenes.tts: The output column is the model's reading. It was not measured directly in every row.
scenes.visual: A note appears under the Smad1 column: the model's reading.
scenes.narration: The output column is the model's reading. It was not measured directly in every row.

scenes.tts: Read down the last two columns. In these four conditions, where the dial was high, the cells made skin. Where it was low, they made neural tissue.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, high (skin) at one end and low (neural) at the other, with three hands reaching for it: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell. The table rows link to the dial: high rows point to skin, low rows to neural. Label on the links: outcomes of the four conditions tested.
scenes.narration: Read down the last two columns. In these four conditions, where the dial was high, the cells made skin. Where it was low, they made neural tissue.

scenes.tts: In a nineteen ninety-seven review, Hemmati-Brivanlou and Melton called this the default model.
scenes.caption: In a 1997 review, Hemmati-Brivanlou and Melton called this the default model.
scenes.visual: Label: 1997, the default model.
scenes.narration: In a 1997 review, Hemmati-Brivanlou and Melton called this the default model.

scenes.tts: In these early cap cultures, neural is the fate frog ectoderm takes when B M P signaling is kept low, while the cells can still respond and their other inputs, such as F G F, are intact. B M P promotes epidermis.
scenes.caption: In these early cap cultures, neural is the fate frog ectoderm takes when BMP signaling is kept low, while the cells can still respond and their other inputs, such as FGF, are intact. BMP promotes epidermis.
scenes.visual: Two arrows labeled as outcomes of the conditions tested: low BMP to neural, high BMP to epidermis. A separate small arrow labeled FGF-dependent input joins the neural arrow.
scenes.narration: In these early cap cultures, neural is the fate frog ectoderm takes when BMP signaling is kept low, while the cells can still respond and their other inputs, such as FGF, are intact. BMP promotes epidermis.

scenes.tts: Default is an operational word. It names the outcome in these cultures, with competent cells and their other inputs intact, not a fate reached with no signals.
scenes.visual: Text on screen: default means the fate when BMP pathway output is low in these cultures, with competent cells and other inputs such as FGF intact; not no signals at all.
scenes.narration: Default is an operational word. It names the outcome in these cultures, with competent cells and their other inputs intact, not a fate reached with no signals.

scenes.tts: Now the third row. The first explanation was dilution.
scenes.visual: Row 3 highlights.
scenes.narration: Now the third row. The first explanation was dilution.

scenes.tts: Separation spreads the cells through a large volume of fluid. The B M P they pass to one another would be diluted away.
scenes.caption: Separation spreads the cells through a large volume of fluid. The BMP they pass to one another would be diluted away.
scenes.visual: Cells drift apart in a large dish; the BMP dots between them thin out and fade.
scenes.narration: Separation spreads the cells through a large volume of fluid. The BMP they pass to one another would be diluted away.

scenes.tts: It was a fair guess. If B M P spreads freely, the physics of diffusion supports it.
scenes.caption: It was a fair guess. If BMP spreads freely, the physics of diffusion supports it.
scenes.visual: A concentration curve falls as the cells move apart. Label: a fair guess.
scenes.narration: It was a fair guess. If BMP spreads freely, the physics of diffusion supports it.

scenes.tts: But later work tested it. B M P receptors keep signaling in separated cells. So how could the dial fall?
scenes.caption: But later work tested it. BMP receptors keep signaling in separated cells. So how could the dial fall?
scenes.visual: The receptors on a separated cell stay lit. Question on screen: receptors active, so how does the dial fall?
scenes.narration: But later work tested it. BMP receptors keep signaling in separated cells. So how could the dial fall?

scenes.tts: Separation switches on lasting signaling by M A P K. It is a kinase cascade, usually started by growth factors such as F G F.
scenes.caption: Separation switches on lasting signaling by MAPK. It is a kinase cascade, usually started by growth factors such as FGF.
scenes.visual: Inside a separated cell, a kinase cascade lights. Label: MAPK, usually started by growth factors such as FGF.
scenes.narration: Separation switches on lasting signaling by MAPK. It is a kinase cascade, usually started by growth factors such as FGF.

scenes.tts: M A P K phosphorylates Smad one in its middle, or linker, region.
scenes.caption: MAPK phosphorylates Smad1 in its middle, or linker, region.
scenes.visual: A Smad1 protein drawn as a bar; a phosphate lands on its middle linker region.
scenes.narration: MAPK phosphorylates Smad1 in its middle, or linker, region.

scenes.tts: That can keep Smad one out of the nucleus and mark it for destruction.
scenes.caption: That can keep Smad1 out of the nucleus and mark it for destruction.
scenes.visual: The marked Smad1 bounces off the nuclear envelope and is broken down.
scenes.narration: That can keep Smad1 out of the nucleus and mark it for destruction.

scenes.tts: The cells need this activity to turn neural. The dial still goes down, by a different hand.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, high (skin) at one end and low (neural) at the other, with three hands reaching for it: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell. The inside-the-cell hand turns the dial down.
scenes.narration: The cells need this activity to turn neural. The dial still goes down, by a different hand.

scenes.tts: And the fourth row? The damping is partial. So enough added B M P four can push the output back up.
scenes.caption: And the fourth row? The damping is partial. So enough added BMP4 can push the output back up.
scenes.visual: Row 4 highlights; extra BMP4 pushes the dial back up past the partial MAPK damping.
scenes.narration: And the fourth row? The damping is partial. So enough added BMP4 can push the output back up.

scenes.tts: That is why the rule names the dial, Smad one in the nucleus. It does not name B M P in the fluid.
scenes.caption: That is why the rule names the dial, Smad1 in the nucleus. It does not name BMP in the fluid.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, high (skin) at one end and low (neural) at the other, with three hands reaching for it: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell.
scenes.narration: That is why the rule names the dial, Smad1 in the nucleus. It does not name BMP in the fluid.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: three hands can turn the dial down. Outside the cell, at the membrane, or inside it.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, high (skin) at one end and low (neural) at the other, with three hands reaching for it: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell. Takeaway on screen: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: three hands can turn the dial down. Outside the cell, at the membrane, or inside it.
